page</button></div><div class="theme-doc-markdown markdown"><header><h1>Position Configuration</h1></header><p>Position data from GPS is provided by either the radio or your paired phone. It is not required to use Meshtastic, but time calculations require at least one device on the mesh to have either a GPS, RTC, or internet connection for NTP.</p>
<p>The position config uses an admin message to send a <code>Config.Position</code> protobuf. The position config options are: GPS Mode, GPS Update Interval, Fixed Position, Smart Broadcast, Smart Broadcast Minimum Distance, Smart Broadcast Minimum Interval, Broadcast Interval, Position Packet Flags, and GPS RX/TX/EN Pins.</p>
<h2 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Y2Ji" id="position-config-values">Position Config Values<a href="#position-config-values" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Position Config Values" title="Direct link to Position Config Values" translate="no">​</a></h2>
<h3 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Y2Ji" id="gps-mode">GPS Mode<a href="#gps-mode" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to GPS Mode" title="Direct link to GPS Mode" translate="no">​</a></h3>
<p>Configures whether the GPS functionality is enabled, disabled, or not present on the node.</p>
<p>Acceptable values: <code>DISABLED</code>, <code>ENABLED</code>, and <code>NOT_PRESENT</code>.</p>
<p>Generally, depending on the device and its configuration, this value will default to either <code>ENABLED</code> or <code>NOT_PRESENT</code>.</p>
<h3 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Y2Ji" id="gps-update-interval">GPS Update Interval<a href="#gps-update-interval" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to GPS Update Interval" title="Direct link to GPS Update Interval" translate="no">​</a></h3>
<p>How often we should try to get GPS position (in seconds), or zero for the default of once every 2 minutes, or a very large value (maxint) to update only once at boot.</p>
<h3 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Y2Ji" id="fixed-position">Fixed Position<a href="#fixed-position" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Fixed Position" title="Direct link to Fixed Position" translate="no">​</a></h3>
<p>Acceptable values: <code>true</code> or <code>false</code></p>
<p>False by default</p>
<p>If set, this node is at a fixed position. The device will generate GPS updates at the regular GPS update interval, but use whatever the last lat/lon/alt it saved for the node. The lat/lon/alt can be set by an internal GPS or with the help of the mobile device's GPS.</p>
<h3 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Y2Ji" id="smart-broadcast">Smart Broadcast<a href="#smart-broadcast" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Smart Broadcast" title="Direct link to Smart Broadcast" translate="no">​</a></h3>
<p>Acceptable values: <code>true</code> or <code>false</code></p>
<p>True by default</p>
<p>Smart broadcast will send out your position at an increased frequency only if your location has changed enough for a position update to be useful.</p>
<p>Smart broadcast complements broadcast interval (doesn't override that setting) but will apply an algorithm to more frequently update your mesh network if you are in motion and then throttle it down when you are standing still. If you use this feature, it's best to leave broadcast interval at the default.</p>
<p>Smart broadcast will calculate an ideal position update interval based on the data rate of your selected channel configuration.</p>
<h3 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Y2Ji" id="smart-broadcast-minimum-distance">Smart Broadcast Minimum Distance<a href="#smart-broadcast-minimum-distance" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Smart Broadcast Minimum Distance" title="Direct link to Smart Broadcast Minimum Distance" translate="no">​</a></h3>
<p>Default of <code>0</code> is 100 meters</p>
<p>The minimum distance in meters traveled (since the last send) before we can send a position to the mesh if smart broadcast is enabled.</p>
<h3 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Y2Ji" id="smart-broadcast-minimum-interval">Smart Broadcast Minimum Interval<a href="#smart-broadcast-minimum-interval" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Smart Broadcast Minimum Interval" title="Direct link to Smart Broadcast Minimum Interval" translate="no">​</a></h3>
<p>Default of <code>0</code> is 30 seconds</p>
<p>The minimum number of seconds (since the last send) before we can send a position to the mesh if smart broadcast is enabled.</p>
<h3 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Y2Ji" id="broadcast-interval">Broadcast Interval<a href="#broadcast-interval" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Broadcast Interval" title="Direct link to Broadcast Interval" translate="no">​</a></h3>
<p>Default of <code>0</code> is 15 minutes</p>
<p>If smart broadcast is off we should send our position this often.</p>
<p>The GPS updates will be sent out every broadcast interval, either with the actual GPS location or an empty location if no GPS fix was achieved.</p>
<h3 class="anchor anchorTargetStickyNavbar_Y2Ji" id="position-flags">Position Flags<a href="#position-flags" class="hash-link" aria-label="Direct link to Position Flags" title="Direct link to Position Flags" translate="no">​</a></h3>
<p>Defines which options are sent in POSITION messages. Values are stored as a bit field of boolean configuration options (bitwise OR of PositionFlags).</p>
